comments.author: Wright
comments.body:
Quest: Meeting a Legend (London Adventurer's Guild)
Difficulty: 9-star
Reqs: Eco R6 / Bio R8 / Far North Languages (Body Language works)

Steps:

1. Oxford Professor
2. St. Petersburg Young Man
3. St. Petersburg Adventure GM
4. Baltic North Sea LP (Upturned Boulder)
5. Use Eco midway between Upturned Boulder and Table Rock in the north

1425 exp upon discovery.

comments.author: Bael
comments.body: It's a Medium Sized Creature, not an Historic Site

comments.author: David
comments.body: You must click the upturned boulder (mid-south west) first to move the quest forward

comments.author: RvZ
comments.body:
Quest name: Meeting a legend (Chrono Quest - 3rd period, 17th Century)
Quest location: London Adventurers' Guild
Skill requirement: r6 Ecological Research, r8 Biology, ARC(Far North Languages)
Pre-requisite discovery/quest: "The meaning of knowing" quest + Orangutan discovery (from "Carried by bird's wings" quest) + St. Petersburg
Additional note: "Main" part of Xanadu/Great Adventurer questchain

wiki: It might be a historic moment to get to this discovery but in the end it is a "Medium Sized Creature" not a "Historic Site"
